name: Tōhō (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Tōhō village emblem in green: a green stylised mountain within an arc, in two shades of green.
history: Municipal flag of Tōhō, a village in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 28 March 2005.

features.role: Tōhō village emblem — a green stylised mountain within an arc, in two shades of green
